name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-shopify-admin
title: Shopify Admin MCP
description: MCP server for the Shopify Admin API: products, orders, customers, inventory, discounts.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Permanent store host, e.g. my-store.myshopify.com (a bare store name works too).

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Ready-made Admin API access token (legacy apps created before 2026-01-01). Alternative to the client id/secret pair.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of a Dev Dashboard app; with the secret the server mints and refreshes its own token.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of that app. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Admin API version: a quarterly YYYY-MM release or unstable.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Full http/https URL of the GraphQL endpoint, replacing host and version (e.g. a local mock).

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on THROTTLED/429 (always) and on 5xx / network errors for reads only.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_TOKEN_LEEWAY_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Re-mint the token this many seconds before it expires.
